scope: Actual compiled-browser failure diagnosis; the subsequent request-reduction fix has source-level regression coverage and still requires a new compiled run

browserEvidence.fileStoreObserver: Read-only subscription located in the actual loaded application; no state setters or fabricated authority
browserEvidence.failedOpen: The clicked document was not opened. The prior document and both load request counters remained unchanged after the failed location lookup.

alreadyAcceptedAtDiagnosedSource.limits: Desktop and isolated mobile cases passed. The subsequent same-server desktop-to-mobile sequence failed from location HTTP 429 and is retained as a failure. These results are not a fully green aggregate.

requestReduction.rule: An exact unexpired current-auth session object already registered by the collaboration HTTP client proves the matching document ID, path, generation and representation for the redundant startup lookup only
